main.route creation description: First of all create the route GPS data. Once you created the GPS data, you'll be able to fill all the route data in a next step.
main.route update description: Modify the route data. You can modify the GPS data and all the other route parameters
main.route creation step1: GPS data generation: use the 'Rec' button tp record a route or upload a GPX file generated with your preferred GPS software or device. The file must be a GPX file. To continue, push the 'Next' button.
main.route creation step2: Route data: to finish and save the route, fill all the requiered fields.
